result.summary: This pull request enables Boost.MultiIndex invariant checking (`BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING`) in two CI environments that already enable safe mode: the 32-bit x86 job without IPC and the native previous releases job. The MSAN fuzz job is intentionally omitted to avoid exceeding the CI execution timeout.
result.problem: Without invariant checking enabled in CI debug builds, subtle corruptions or invariant violations in Boost.MultiIndex containers (notably in the mempool) may go undetected during test runs.

resolved_concerns: fanquake pointed out that the MSAN fuzz job timed out when invariant checking was enabled; the author excluded that job and verified local run times, which jeanpablojp confirmed.

result.card: This pull request defines BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING in two CI test environment configurations to trigger automatic container invariant validation during debug test runs. It solves the problem of subtle container inconsistencies passing CI unnoticed, specifically for data structures like the mempool that rely on Boost.MultiIndex. The change is small and deliberately skips the MSAN fuzz job to prevent runner timeouts. Review is ready, with an Approach ACK and timing reproduction from jeanpablojp, and no open blockers.
